title: liquiditybot — problem / solution
description: Every failure mode as a PROBLEM whose panel shows the live detector and names the SOLUTION mechanism handling it — including the audit chain's and telemetry's own health.

options.content: **Incident board — a calm board is all green.** Every tile is a PROBLEM paired with the SOLUTION that fires automatically; any non-zero / amber / red panel is a live incident worth a look. Counter families are ranked bars — the tallest bar is the incident. Refresh 30s · window 24h.
